A hollow trunk. Something has been stashed inside.
Abandoned junk, rusted through. Break it up for scrap iron.
Rotting canvas and cloth. Cut it up for cloth.
Brittle old plastic and rubber. Break it up for polymers.
Cracked old leather. Salvage what is left.
A tent camp somebody left behind long ago. Salvage what is left of it.
A collapsed lean-to and its fire ring. Salvage what is left of it.

A rotting trail marker. Chop it up for wood.
A collapsed stack of old firewood. Chop it up for wood.
A wild plant. Harvest it for plant fibers.
